refactor: replace Babel-injected unid with C++ atomic counter

Remove the entire Babel-to-C++-to-JS pipeline for the unid mechanism:
- C++ now generates unique stylesheet tags via std::atomic counter
- Removes dead code from JS (readonly unid property was never read)
- Web create.ts no longer needs the id parameter
- Simplifies Babel plugin by removing stringToUniqueId() injection

All 38 plugin and mock tests pass. Hot reload safety verified: registry
is wiped on full Live Reload, minor dev-only leak on Fast Refresh.
fix: remove unused error import in web create.ts
perf: avoid double map lookup in addStyleSheet

feat: make react-native-edge-to-edge optional

Since v3.1.0, react-native-edge-to-edge is optional. Unistyles enables
edge-to-edge layout automatically on Android if the package is not
installed. This aligns with Expo SDK 54's transition away from this
dependency in favor of React Native's built-in enableEdgeToEdge property.

- Mark react-native-edge-to-edge as optional in peerDependenciesMeta
- Update README installation instructions
- Update v3 documentation with rationale and guidance
docs: add enableEdgeToEdge gradle property info for bare RN users
fix: use astro syntax for code highlighting

feat: skip edge-to-edge fallback when already enabled

Check if edge-to-edge is already enabled at the window level
before applying the fallback. This handles the case where
React Native's enableEdgeToEdge gradle property has already
configured edge-to-edge before Unistyles initializes.
fix: use correct edgeToEdgeEnabled gradle.properties name

docs: strongly recommend edgeToEdgeEnabled property

The edgeToEdgeEnabled gradle property does more than just enabling
edge-to-edge layout. It enforces statusBarTranslucent and
navigationBarTranslucent on modals, disables backgroundColor and
translucent on StatusBar, and enables additional RN core fixes.
